verdict.rationale: Motion documents a public API for creating, updating, and managing projects and tasks, available to all users, with an API reference covering its endpoints. Nothing shows that the API matches what the UI can do: the documented scope is limited to projects and tasks, while the UI also offers booking pages, meeting templates, the notetaker, search, the workflow builder, dashboards and time tracking. Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for calendar/meeting booking, templates, notes, workflows, dashboards and reporting, any explicit UI–API parity statement, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
